lineage: Netlib Fortran ODE solvers descended from GEAR (1974): variable-step variable-order Adams (non-stiff) and BDF (stiff) methods with error control, a corrector iteration and a Jacobian strategy chosen by the method flag MF. Sibling of QUADPACK/EISPACK in the vault; ancestor of scipy.integrate.odeint (which wraps LSODA).
version: netlib odepack (double precision: opkdmain.f, opkda1.f, opkda2.f), as fetched 2026-09-12

license.status: public domain (US government work, LLNL); see opkdmain.f header

dependencies: none (opkda2.f bundles the LINPACK/BLAS routines it needs)
entry_points: DLSODE(F, NEQ, Y, T, TOUT, ITOL, RTOL, ATOL, ITASK, ISTATE, IOPT, RWORK, LRW, IWORK, LIW, JAC, MF)

example.input: the Robertson stiff chemical kinetics problem
example.output: MF=21 (BDF) integrates to t=4e10 in a few hundred steps; MF=10 (Adams, non-stiff) fails: ISTATE=-1 (too many steps) -- the PATHOLOGY, method vs problem

upstream_docs: Hindmarsh, ODEPACK, A Systematized Collection of ODE Solvers, 1983
Radhakrishnan & Hindmarsh, Description and Use of LSODE, LLNL UCRL-ID-113855, 1993

human_capability_summary.built_to: integrate ODE systems with automatic step and order selection, including stiff systems whose fast modes would otherwise force absurdly small steps
human_capability_summary.pressure: stiffness: time scales separated by 10^10 in Robertson's problem; error tolerances; work limits
human_capability_summary.success_means: the requested tolerance is met in a bounded number of steps; a method mismatched to the problem is reported, not silently wrong

known_human_problem_solved: stiff and non-stiff initial value problems
human_environmental_pressure: stiffness (widely separated time scales), accuracy tolerance, step budget
human_failure_condition: the non-stiff method's stability region forces steps ~1/|lambda|: the integrator exhausts its step budget (ISTATE=-1) or diverges
behavioral_entry_point: switch MF between 10 (Adams) and 21 (BDF + user Jacobian) on the same problem and tolerance; vary MXSTEP

lineage_relations.note: LSODA (in this same package) auto-switches; wrapped by SciPy

nyx_handoff.how_to_run_it: recipe.json (runner docker); python -m techne.fossils.harvest run odepack-netlib
nyx_handoff.what_humans_used_it_for: integrate ODE systems with automatic step and order selection, including stiff systems whose fast modes would otherwise force absurdly small steps
